pain.h2:
The problem isn't a lack of information.
It's that it contradicts itself.
pain.lead: You've already watched dozens of videos. You know what a routine is. And still nothing has moved in six months. Here's why.
pain.c1:
Three answers to one question

One creator says one thing, the next says the opposite. You don't know who to follow, so you do nothing — or you alternate, which comes to the same thing.
pain.c2:
Starting everything at once

New routine, new sport, new diet, all on the same Monday. Five habits in parallel: the load is too heavy, and the whole thing collapses around day 12.
pain.c3:
No reference point

Without a starting photo, gradual change is invisible to someone who looks at himself every morning. You may already be making progress, but you can't see it — so you quit.
pain.verdict: What's missing isn't motivation, it's the sequence. What order to work in, what to ignore for the first few weeks, and when to add the next piece. That is exactly what MARLglow does.
seq.h2: Three blocks. One piece at a time.
seq.lead: Each block installs what makes the next one possible. You never add more than two habits at the same time.
seq.p1:
Clear the base

What delivers the most and that almost nobody does seriously. Nothing spectacular, but it's what holds.

  • Skin assessment, then a minimal routine — the exact order of steps
  • The MARLglow massage, every day, with no product at all
  • Sleep and hydration: the simple protocol that makes the rest visible
  • Starting photo in controlled light + measurements
seq.p2:
Build the structure

Once the base is stable, you work on what changes your physique and the way it is perceived.

  • Short targeted sessions: shoulders, back, neck, posterior chain
  • Posture work: the movements that change how you carry your head
  • A simple nutrition frame, without counting every gram
  • Stepping up the face routine
seq.p3:
Reveal

The work is done. What's left is not ruining it with a haircut that doesn't suit you and clothes in the wrong size.

  • A haircut that fits your face shape: the exact words to tell your barber
  • What changes the most for the least money on clothes
  • Posture, eye contact, pace: presence in a photo and in person
  • Final photo in the same conditions as the first

faq.q1:
When do I get access?

Immediately. As soon as payment is confirmed, Shopify sends your access to the email address on the order. If nothing arrives within 10 minutes, check your spam folder then contact us.
faq.q2:
Do I need a gym? A product budget?

No to both. The block 2 sessions have an equipment-free version you can do at home. And the MARLglow massage needs no product at all — just your hands. If you do want to buy, the Full Pack tells you what to get and, more importantly, what to avoid.
faq.q3:
Is 70 days realistic?

It depends on your starting point. Sleep, posture, haircut and style show within a few weeks. Skin needs a full renewal cycle. A major physical transformation goes beyond 70 days — the method starts it properly, it does not finish it. We'd rather say so.
faq.q4:
Is there bone smashing, mewing?

No, and that's deliberate. Those techniques have no serious evidence behind them and some are dangerous. MARLglow works on what is actually changeable in 70 days: skin, physique, posture, hair, style and presence. That already accounts for most of the gap between two photos.
faq.q5:
What's the difference between €12 and the Full Pack?

At €12 you get the entire MARLglow method — the complete 70-day protocol. The Full Pack adds two advanced techniques: the no-product skin massage, and the filter on what's on the market. Nothing is removed from the base method.
faq.q6:
Is this a subscription?

No. One payment, lifetime access, no recurring charge.
faq.q7:
How old do I have to be?

Purchases are restricted to adults. Under 18, the order must be placed by a parent or guardian.
